data.content_ref: inline:Contradiction: the neighborhood's stated covering principle (SRC_011: admissible strengthening = polynomial-time monotone edge-construction enrichment before the skeptical fixpoint) is contradicted by the post-hoc diagnostic foundations (SRC_002, SRC_004, SRC_003, SRC_008), which are admissible strengthening applied AFTER the fixpoint. If the covering principle is truly universal, either the post-hoc diagnostics are outside the admissible class (and should be reclassified as observations, not strengthenings) or the principle must be revised to include post-fixpoint polynomial annotations. REFUTED IF there is a consistent reading of SRC_011 that includes post-hoc annotations as admissible strengthenings without modifying its core monotone edge-construction claim.
